subject: MAP: ramp trajectory, monthly TPM targets & final commit timing
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie.park@brightretail.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: chris.torres@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — initial targets and asks

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the latency numbers and the streaming behavior look promising for our in-app assistant. Procurement asked me to formalize an evaluation / MAP so we can align internal stakeholders (ML, infra, procurement) against a timeline to move from PoC -> paid commit. Two things we want to lock down up front: monthly TPM targets (so we can budget tokens) and a tentative ramp schedule tied to discounts.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a 60-day evaluation plan with clear milestones and a proposed commit ramp that moves us to production within 4 months? Specifically we're considering a target of ~500M tokens/month at steady state, but we'd like a staged ramp so we don't overcommit early. Procurement also wants to understand how discounts scale with committed volume.

Attached: our internal evaluation checklist and an RFx we run for vendor comparisons.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0–4: integration + small eval (10–30M tokens/month)
- Week 5–8: larger eval and model tuning (50–150M tokens/month)
- Month 3–4: go-live ramp to target steady state (target 400–600M TPM)

Can Redwood share a draft MAP that ties pricing tiers to monthly TPM buckets, plus an SOW template and options for a trial credit or reduced price during the evaluation window? If we can agree on milestones and commercial terms, procurement can push finance to accelerate an FPO in early August.

Thanks — would appreciate a draft by Thursday so we can review ahead of our cross-functional sync.

Best,
Julie Park
Head of ML, BrightRetail
julie.park@brightretail.com

Attachments: BrightRetail_eval_checklist.pdf (pdf), BR-RFx-2026.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@brightretail.com>
Cc: chris.torres@brightretail.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — initial targets and asks

Julie — thanks for the clear scope and timeline. I've drafted a short MAP and pricing proposal that maps to the stages you've outlined. Key points below; attached is a one-page MAP + SOW draft and a pricing spreadsheet.

Summary proposal (draft):
- Evaluation phase (60 days):
  - Week 0–4: integration + smoke tests — recommended cap 30M tokens/month (trial discount = 50% list for first 30M).
  - Week 5–8: evaluation phase volume 50–150M tokens/month (discount = 30% list on usage above first 30M during eval).
- Ramp to steady state (months 3–6):
  - Month 3: 100M TPM
  - Month 4: 250M TPM
  - Month 5: 400M TPM
  - Month 6+: target steady state 500M TPM
- Commercial mechanics:
  - Commit structure: quarterly minimums — we propose an initial 6‑month commitment with monthly reporting and a 30‑day review at month 2 and month 4.
  - Discounts: tiered by cumulative 30‑day tokens; up to 18% annualized discount at >=4B tokens committed across 12 months. Additional 5% for enterprise SLA add-on.
  - Ramp protection: we can allow a two-month grace on early undershoot (credits applied to next quarter) to give you flexibility during tune.

Open items we need from BrightRetail:
- Confirmation of desired steady-state TPM and acceptable initial monthly minima.
- Any procurement constraints for commit language (auto-renew, true-ups, termination rights).

Next steps: if this aligns, can we schedule a 30‑minute call Friday to finalize the MAP and align on SOW language? I've attached: BrightRetail_MAP_v1.pdf, SOW_draft_BRD-0421.docx, pricing_table_v3.xlsx.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: BrightRetail_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf), SOW_draft_BRD-0421.docx (docx), pricing_table_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightRetail — ramp/discount counter and approval asks

Team — forwarding Julie's ask and the draft MAP I sent. Procurement is pushing for faster runway to 500M TPM by month 4; they want stronger discounts tied to earlier commits. My commercial counter (proposal B) below reduces customer risk while protecting our unit economics. Please weigh in with margin impact and legal redlines.

Proposal B (our recommended public counter):
- Evaluation (unchanged): 2‑month trial with the same early caps and trial discount.
- Frontloaded ramp cadence: Month 3 = 150M TPM, Month 4 = 350M TPM, Month 5+ = 500M TPM. This gets them to steady state faster.
- Discount corridor:
  - 0–999M/mo cumulative annualized: base discount 10%
  - 1B–2.9B: 15%
  - 3B+: 20%
  - Enterprise SLA add-on: +5%
- Commitment mechanics: 6‑month initial commitment with opt-in auto-renew and standard true-up at quarter close. Undershoot protection: up to 15% of committed tokens may be carried as credit to next quarter.

Risks / asks:
- We need a legal greenlight on opt-in auto-renew + true-up language — last time procurement pushed hard here.
- Finance: confirm that a 15–20% discount corridor still meets EBITDA targets for Dedicated/Hosted mixes (we'll need a blended rate calc).

Marissa — can you confirm if we can give the +5% SLA incentive for a 3‑year deal? Karthik — need your input on pricing_table_v3 assumptions (model mix, quantization impact). Laura — procurement will likely ask for DocuSign with SOW + redlines; please prep a curated clause set.

Thanks — want to be responsive but not concede too much on discount depth.

Best,
Aditya

> On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 10:02 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Julie — thanks for the clear scope... (MAP summary attached)

From: Julie Park <julie.park@brightretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Torres <chris.torres@brightretail.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — initial targets and asks

Aditya — appreciate the speed. We reviewed both your initial draft and Proposal B internally. Good news: procurement is comfortable with Proposal B's frontloaded ramp if you can commit to the following clarifications: 

1) Firm month-by-month TPM targets in the SOW (we need exact numbers to allocate budget). We propose the following minor change to your frontload: Month 3 = 140M, Month 4 = 340M, Month 5 = 500M.
2) Discounting: replace the cumulative bands with a monthly-averaged commit band for the first 6 months only (makes our finance modeling simpler). Keep the SLA add-on.
3) Evaluation credits: we accept trial discount on first 30M and 30% on evaluation excess, but request that unused evaluation credits be refundable against first month after contract execution (not only carried forward).

If Redwood can accept 1–3 above, we can route the SOW to legal and sign the 6‑month initial commitment next week. Please send a final pricing_table and DocuSign bundle; we'll get Procurement to sign off.

I'll attach a short MAP acceptance note for signatures. Looking forward to closing — team is excited to move to production.

Best,
Julie Park
Head of ML, BrightRetail
